video_caption: The video opens with a man in a brown plaid blazer and black shirt, smiling and looking up, then transitions to him screaming with an open mouth, followed by a different man in a white floral print shirt screaming into a microphone; both clips feature a static, grainy effect. A title card appears with the text "Weekly DUMB" above two men seated at a wooden desk with neon green microphones. The man on the left wears a light blue blazer over a dark patterned shirt, while the man on the right wears a brown plaid blazer over a light shirt. The background includes shelves with various items, a light blue jersey with "BAGGAGE 14," and a large poster of a baseball player. The man in the light blue blazer introduces himself as Jimmy and the other as Jake, then states, "this is The Weekly Dumb," referencing a previous weekend where Jake was "dumb." The man in the brown plaid blazer, Jake, recounts his trip to Brooklyn, pointing at the camera and then gesturing with excitement. An animated map showing "BROOKLYN" and "HERE" over the corresponding borough appears on a screen in the background, with a "DraftKings" logo beneath it. The men discuss their activities, with Jake mentioning looking at apartments and Jimmy asking if he walked the Brooklyn Bridge, to which Jake replies he did not. The segment concludes with the man in the light blue blazer picking up a piece of paper from the desk.

Two men are co-hosting a podcast in a room with shelves displaying various memorabilia and a large poster. The first man, with dark hair and wearing a pink plaid blazer over a light shirt, initially appears speaking into a microphone. At 0:08, he is replaced by the second man, who has grey hair and a beard, wearing a light blue/green blazer, holding a black baseball bat across his chest. Overlay text prominently displays "NO ONE CARES BOY" during this segment. The video then alternates between close-ups of each man speaking. At 0:18, "NC STATE WOLF PACK" with a wolf head logo appears over the second man. The first man gestures with his hands to form "wolf ears." From 0:23, a video clip of a baseball player hitting the ball is shown on the left side of the screen while the second man continues to speak. At 0:29, both men are seen sitting at a wooden desk, with a "Weekly DUMB" and "DRAFT KINGS" graphic on a screen behind them, and scores "7" and "6.5" displayed on shelves. The conversation focuses on a baseball player named Tommy White, with clips of him playing on the left side of the screen (0:34-0:40, 0:52-0:56). At 1:07, a Twitter post is displayed, showing a tweet from "@Pack9 @NCSUBaseball" celebrating "@tommywhite44 TANKS a grand slam to center !!" with details: "B6 | #Pack9 6, Evansville 0" and the date "Feb 19, 2022," while the first man discusses Tommy White's nicknames like "Three Bomb Tom," "Big Country," and "Tommy Tanks," before asserting that "Tommy Tanks" is the winner. The "NOOM WEIGHT noom.com/jomboy" advertisement remains visible in the top right corner throughout the video.

The video features two men, presumably in a podcast studio, speaking into bright green microphones. The first man, wearing a pink plaid suit jacket over a cream shirt, initially looks down at a paper before looking up and smiling while speaking. The second man, with graying hair and a beard, wears a light green suit jacket over a dark shirt, and frequently looks directly at the camera with his hands clasped, often with a slight smile while speaking. From 0:02 to 0:06, large purple and green text "almost A BREAKDOWN" appears as an overlay over the second man. The background consists of shelves holding various items including a white ceramic head, a football, a white teddy bear, and framed pictures, one of which appears to be a cartoon drawing of two men. Also visible are a large poster of a baseball player in a white Yankees uniform holding a hot dog, and a light blue jersey with "JM BAGGAGE 14" on it; both the poster and jersey display the text "NOOM WEIGHT, NOOM.COM/JOMBOY".

The video features two men, presumably hosts, speaking into a bright green microphone in what appears to be a studio setting. The first man, with short dark hair, wears a reddish-brown and white plaid jacket over a light-colored shirt, holding a piece of paper and smiling briefly. Behind him, a shelf holds various items including a caricature of a man's head, a football, and other decor, while a large poster of a baseball player in a white Yankees uniform with "NOOM" visible at the top is positioned to his right. The second man, with short grey hair and a beard, wears a light blue/green suit jacket over a patterned shirt, speaking directly into the camera and using hand gestures; his background includes framed pictures and a light blue jersey hanging on the wall that reads "JM BAGGAGE 14" and "NOOM" (which is repeated on a white label above the jersey, likely part of a website address "NOOM.COM/JOMBOY"). At one point, a vertical video briefly appears on the left side of the screen, showing an indoor restaurant or cafeteria with tables and chairs where a person is seen using a long stick or pole on the floor, with a "TikTok" watermark visible at the bottom left of this embedded video.

In this video segment, two men are seated at a wooden table in what appears to be a podcast or studio setting, with green and black microphones in front of them, as they comment on a separate video playing on the left side of the screen. The man on the left, wearing a plaid jacket and a light-colored shirt, makes various hand gestures such as clenching his fists (0:00), pointing an index finger (0:06, 0:22), and extending an open palm (0:53). The man on the right, dressed in a light green blazer and a dark patterned shirt, gestures with both hands as if explaining (0:02), points off-screen (0:08), makes a quick pushing motion (0:15, 0:31), spreads his hands wide (0:19), raises his fists (0:38), points downwards (0:42), and makes a flicking motion (0:49). The inset video clip shows a raccoon in an indoor dining area, where a man attempts to hit it with a broom, making it jump (0:19-0:21), while another man tries to use a large gray recycling bin to capture or guide the raccoon, at one point lifting the bin upwards over the raccoon instead of lowering it (0:38-0:40). The raccoon is seen scurrying across the floor (0:36), and a "TikTok" logo with the username "@adrianne.bajan" is visible in the lower left corner of the inset video. In the background of the studio, shelves hold various items including a head-shaped object, a football, a plush toy, framed pictures (one with a cartoon drawing of two men), and a blue baseball jersey with "BAGGAGE" and "14" on it, along with a large poster of a baseball player that reads "NOOM" and "JOMBOY."

The video opens with two men seated behind a wooden desk. The man on the right, wearing a pink and white plaid jacket over a light-colored collared shirt, speaks into a green microphone, gesturing with his right hand, pointing, and then clenching his fist. The man on the left, in a light green jacket over a dark patterned shirt, listens and occasionally nods. In the background, shelves display various items, including a football, framed pictures, and sneakers, alongside a large poster of a baseball player in a Yankees uniform. Text in the upper right corner reads "NOOM WEIGHT" and "NOOM.COM/JOMBOY", indicating a sponsor. The camera then widens, showing a screen behind them displaying "Weekly Dumb" in a decorative font, with the DraftKings logo beneath it, likely the title of the segment. The man on the right picks up a paper while the man on the left speaks and gestures. The camera briefly focuses on the smiling face of the man on the left, then on the man on the right who is also smiling. A third person, wearing a grey hoodie and black Adidas track pants, enters the frame from the right, leans over the desk, and begins to scratch at the surface with their hands while making chittering noises, mimicking a raccoon. Both seated men laugh, with the man on the left smiling widely. The camera widens again as the "raccoon" stands up and exits the frame to the left, while the two men continue to smile.

The video features two men sitting at a wooden desk, each with a microphone. The man on the left wears a light blue blazer over a patterned dark shirt, and the man on the right wears a pink plaid jacket over a light yellow shirt. Both men are speaking and interacting, often looking at each other or directly at the camera. The background includes shelves adorned with various items like a football, figurines, framed pictures (one showing two cartoon men, one in a Yankees uniform), and a large poster of a baseball player in a Yankees uniform. A blue and multicolor jersey with "BAGGAGE 14" written on it hangs on the wall. Text overlays appear at various points: "NOOM WEIGHT NOOM.COM/JOMBOY" is visible from 0:08 to 0:18. Later, a full shot reveals a whiteboard behind them displaying "Penis Frozen Counter: 2" with a green "DRAFT KINGS" logo underneath. During a discussion about a frozen penis, a picture-in-picture window appears showing a male skier in a blue and white racing suit lying on the snow, with parts of his face covered in snow, and the word "OLYMPICS" visible on his bib. Briefly, around 0:50, a confetti graphic bursts around the man in the pink jacket. The video concludes with a graphic covering the scene, showing colorful balloons and the text "Balloon Man."

In a brightly lit studio with shelves displaying sports memorabilia and a large Yankees poster, two men sit at a wooden desk adorned with a "JOMBOY Media" logo and a green "DraftKings" neon sign behind them. The man on the left wears a light blue/green blazer over a patterned shirt, while the man on the right wears a plaid jacket and a beige shirt. Both speak into green microphones, reading from papers and gesturing. An inset video appears on the left, showing an older man named Julius, initially surrounded by balloons and later inflating a large green balloon, then seen near a pool and holding a red balloon, and finally amidst many colorful balloons. The men discuss Julius's love for balloons, noting he's 62 years old and married, and possesses over 50,000 balloons. The man in the blazer expresses amusement and disbelief, while the man in the plaid jacket quotes Julius, saying, "Intellectually, I know that the balloons are not alive... I'm not dumb," then adding, "But sometimes I wonder if my love for them brings them to life." White text then appears on screen (0:54), listing Julius's descriptions of balloons: "Beautiful," "Soft," "Smooth," "Delicate." The men agree with these descriptions. Finally, they both read aloud from their papers, with text appearing on a large screen behind them (1:10): "THERE'S NOTHING WRONG WITH LOVING BALLOONS. IT'S NOT DANGEROUS AND IT'S NOT HURTING ANYBODY." The man in the plaid jacket makes a "facts" gesture, and a text overlay reads "FAX" (1:20). The segment concludes with the man in the blazer pondering, and the screen behind them changes to display "Weekly DUMB" (1:26). Throughout the video, "NOOM WEIGHT" and "NOOM.COM/JOMBOY" are visible in the top right corner.

The video segment features two men, presumably hosts of a show, seated at a wooden desk with black legs, each speaking into a green microphone. The man on the left, with short grey hair and a beard, wears a light blue-green plaid suit jacket over a dark patterned shirt. The man on the right, with short brown hair and a light beard, wears a reddish-brown plaid suit jacket over a light yellow shirt. Throughout the video, both men react with smiles and gestures as they converse. The background features white walls adorned with shelves holding various items including a football, framed pictures, a light blue jersey with "BAGGAGE 14" printed on it, and a large poster of a baseball player in a New York Yankees uniform. A monitor above the desk displays different graphics; initially, it shows a black creature (possibly a raccoon or bear) holding a red balloon with "NOOM" (NOOM) written on it, accompanied by neon green "Draft Kings" text. Later, the monitor displays "Weekly DUMB," which then transitions to an animated sequence where "JOMBOY Media" appears in large white letters, followed by "Employee of the Week" in a golden, flowing script, with a white flash effect. In the top right corner of the screen, the text "NOOM (NOOM) WEIGHT (WEIGHT) NOOM.COM/JOMBOY (NOOM.COM/JOMBOY)" is consistently visible, suggesting a sponsorship. The man in the reddish-brown plaid jacket also makes a "pffft" sound with his lips at one point.

The video opens with a man in a light blue blazer and a patterned shirt, with grey hair and a beard, speaking into a neon green microphone at a wooden desk. Behind him are shelves holding framed pictures, including one with two cartoon figures, and a blue jersey with "JM BAGGAGE 14" printed on it, along with a "NOOM WEIGHT" logo in the top right. At 0:04, the scene expands to show two men at the wooden desk: the man in the blue blazer on the left and another man in a plaid blazer on the right, both with neon green microphones. A large golden ornate frame is superimposed in the center, displaying a video of two men in hoodies with "JM" logos, identified by text overlays as "CHRIS ROSE" and "JOEZ MCFLY". The word "Weekly" is above the frame, and "JOMBOY Media" is below. The man in the plaid blazer claps. The shot briefly returns to just the man in the blue blazer speaking (0:11-0:12), then cuts to the man in the plaid blazer speaking (0:22-0:23). At 0:23, both men are back at the desk, and the golden frame reappears, but now it's empty with black text that reads "NOT KELSEY WINGERT" (NOT KELSEY WINGERT). Above the frame, "Weekly DUMB" is visible in a stylized font, with "DRAFTKINGS" also appearing. The video cuts back to the man in the blue blazer speaking (0:29-0:31). Finally, the screen splits: the man in the blue blazer is on the right, speaking into his microphone, while the left side shows a video of two men in a warehouse-like setting, one pitching and one batting in what appears to be a Wiffle ball game, with a scoreboard displaying "0-0-0" for both teams in the upper left corner of the split screen.

A man with grey hair and a beard, dressed in a light blue blazer over a dark patterned shirt, is speaking intently into a bright green microphone. In the background to his left, a monitor displays two men in white and purple baseball jerseys facing each other on a dark stage, one wearing jersey number "24," with a "BASEBALL BATTLE" logo at the bottom. To his right, a light blue jersey with the partial text "BAGGAGE" hangs, and shelves with framed pictures and other items are visible. In the upper right corner of the screen, a "NOOM" logo with the text "NOOM.COM / HUMPHREY" is displayed. The man then raises a black shirt with a repeating green frog pattern in front of his face, obscuring his mouth and the microphone as he holds it up with both hands.

The video segment features a static image displaying the Noom Weight logo against a soft, light beige background with a subtle vignette effect. The word "NOOM" is prominently displayed in a black, rounded sans-serif font. To the right of "NOOM," within a black, horizontally-oriented rounded rectangle, the word "WEIGHT" is written in white, uppercase sans-serif letters. There are no people, actions, or significant environmental details visible beyond the logo and its background.

The video begins with an advertisement showing the "NOOM WEIGHT" logo and the website "NOOM.COM/JOMBOY" (Noom.com/Jomboy) against a light, textured background. This transitions to a studio setting where two men are seated at a wooden desk adorned with the "JOMBOY Media" logo. The man on the left, dressed in a light teal blazer over a patterned shirt, holds a clear glass and animatedly discusses MoviePass, frequently gesturing with his hands and displaying expressive facial reactions, at one point touching his eye to emphasize a point about eye-tracking technology. The man on the right, wearing a plaid brown and pink blazer, listens intently and occasionally smiles or speaks into his microphone. Behind them, shelves filled with framed pictures, a light blue baseball jersey with "BAGGAGE 14" on it, and other sports memorabilia are visible, while a screen above the desk displays "Weekly DUMB" and "DRAFT KINGS".
